label: LLDP
notes: Link Layer Discovery Protocol (IEEE 802.1AB) over Ethernet, EtherType 0x88cc. LLDP is a TLV chain, so only the mandatory first TLV (Chassis ID) sits at a fixed offset: chassis_length is the 9-bit TLV length in the word at offset 0 and chassis_subtype is the first value byte. The 7-bit TLV type in the same word is always 1 (chassis id) and carries no filtering value, and the chassis id value itself is an address-like blob; both are left out. Port ID, Time To Live and every later TLV shift with the chassis id length, so they fail the fixed-offset rule and are not modelled. headerLength is the canonical minimal LLDPDU of the recipe (MAC-address chassis id, port name eth0, TTL 120, end TLV).

fields.label: Chassis ID TLV Length
fields.description: Length of the Chassis ID TLV value in bytes (the subtype byte plus the chassis id); 7 for a MAC-address chassis id.

excluded.reason: chassis ID value (variable length) and the Port ID / TTL / End TLVs; offsets shift with the chassis ID length, so only the first TLV header sits at a fixed offset
